name: PyTorch & Deep Learning Fine-Tuning
description: Model training, LoRA/PEFT parameter-efficient fine-tuning, evaluation metrics, and GPU acceleration workflows.
best_practices: Mixed precision training: Use torch.cuda.amp.autocast with fp16 or bf16 to reduce VRAM consumption and boost compute.
Gradient checkpointing: Trade minor compute for substantial memory savings on deep transformer layers.
Validation loss early stopping: Track validation metrics with early stopping to prevent overfitting.
Reproducible random seeding: Explicitly seed torch and numpy generators for deterministic results.
Parameter-efficient fine-tuning: Combine 4-bit quantization with LoRA adapters for efficient resource utilization.
